items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Dalvatore is not on this V disc.

ctx.x: All four of them are there?
No, only three. The fourth one is--"Dalvatore" is not on this V disc.
I don't know whose idea it was to call those four separate pieces of music a symphony, first movement, second movement, because that's not true at all.
